**Triage: `domain:spec`; `Bug`; `priority:p2`; `pm:queue`. `finding` stripped (定级即离标).**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+178 · 2026-09-11T03:4xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `58a4fada7c7a74c3c32628086f4a639c855ac5a8`.

### Why `Bug` — the card names the governing principle and it is the deciding one

⭐ 「Under the maintainer's principle this is the forbidden direction: **objectui is narrower than the protocol** on published metadata.」

⇒ that is a declared contract contradicted, ⛔ not a gap to fill: the spec emits `{default, description, title, type}` for `PostgresConfigSchema.properties.host` and objectui's head emits `{description, type}`. Measured through the emitter (`z.toJSONSchema`), on both sides, with the pre-#9086 base as a third reading. ⇒ `Bug`.

### Why p2

⛔ Not p1 — nothing is refused, nothing renders wrong, and no author is blocked; the meta is **absent**, not incorrect. ⛔ Not p3 — the loss is on the **published** surface (11 `ZodDefault` nodes losing `title` ×9 / `externalVocabulary` ×2, on Mongo/Mysql/Postgres `host` and `port`, Postgres `schema`, Sqlite/SqliteWasm `filename`, `AuthConfigSchema.session.expiresIn`, `DisasterRecoveryPlanSchema.failover.dns.ttl`), and 「narrower than the protocol」 is the direction the platform has ruled against. ⇒ it is a contract drift that gets more expensive per consumer, ⛔ not a cosmetic one.

### ⭐ The docblock finding is the durable half — ⛔ do not fix the code and leave the sentence

`packages/types/src/zod/imported-defaults.ts:144-147` enshrines 「⛔ The description and nothing else」 on a rationale about `id`. The card's measurement:

| key | occurrences in the spec's registry meta on this surface |
|---|--:|
| `id` (the key the docblock defends against) | **0** |
| `title` (a key it silently drops) | **27** |

⇒ ⭐ **the sentence guards an absent key and is silent about the present ones.** A round that widens the carry-set and leaves that docblock standing has left the next reader the same false reason. ⇒ the deliverable is both: the carry-set **and** the sentence, which should either name the real trade-off or narrow to 「never `id`」.

### Two sites, and ⛔ the second is not optional

- ① `stripImportedDefaults` — the 11 `ZodDefault` nodes above.
- ② `packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts:180-183` — the identical `new Ctor({...def, ...patch})` rebuild shape, measured losing the **container's** description (`deriveStrictAuthoringSchema(z.object({k: z.string().describe('LEAF')}).describe('CONTAINER'))` returns a container with no description; the leaf keeps `'LEAF'`).

⇒ objectui#9086 fixed one site of this shape; ⚠️ ⛔ fixing ① and leaving ② reproduces the split the card exists to close. ⭐ The shared `{...def, ...patch}` rebuild is the actual defect — ⇒ the PR should say why the two sites cannot share one helper, if they cannot.

### ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ **Do not widen the carry-set to "everything".** The card measures **six** meta keys present on this surface (`title` ×27, `default` ×18, `externalVocabulary` ×6, `format` ×3, `xRef` ×2, `xExpression` ×2). ⇒ carry what the protocol publishes; ⛔ a blanket spread is a different change with a different blast radius.
- ⛔ **Do not touch `@objectstack/spec`.** It is the reference and it is correct — that is the whole premise.
- ⚠️ **Re-derive every count and address.** These are from the reviewer's run; objectui `main` moved three times in the previous hour alone.

### ⚠️ Family note — three sibling findings, one file family

**#9088** (`bug`, `domain:spec`, `package: types`, **still ungraded**) and **#9103** (graded this round) are the other two residues of the same review. ⇒ all three touch `imported-defaults.ts` / its tests. ⛔ Not duplicates — ⚠️ but same-file serialisation applies among them, and #9088 has no pm-state yet, so it is invisible to the queue. Whoever takes any of the three should read the other two first.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T03:4xZ, 437-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `stripImportedDefaults` | **2** — #9102, #9088 |
| `strict-authoring-face` | **4** — #9102, #8346, #8345, #8344 |
| `externalVocabulary` | **1** — #9102 |
| `registry meta\|title` (control) | **96** |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#8344** (`pm:dispatched`) / **#8345** / **#8346** (both `pm:blocked`) are the strict-authoring-face *construction* lineage — they build that face; this card is about a **loss** inside its rebuild. ⚠️ #8344 is in flight and touches that file family ⇒ check its surface before dispatching site ②.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — two sites, a carry-set decision bounded by six measured keys, and a docblock that has to stop defending the wrong key.
